name: Minimal Centered Hero
purpose: Introduce the product with high clarity and generous whitespace.
compositionNotes: Use concise copy and avoid visual clutter.

name: Split UI Preview
purpose: Pair product explanation with a clean interface preview.
compositionNotes: Good when a product screenshot-like visual is needed early.

name: Feature Row Stack
purpose: Explain features in a calm linear sequence.
compositionNotes: Use after hero for lightweight products.

name: Three Column Benefits
purpose: Summarize core benefits without heavy card design.
compositionNotes: Keep each item short and parallel.

name: Product Walkthrough Tabs
purpose: Show multiple product states without a long page.
compositionNotes: Use when PRD has multiple user modes or workflows.

name: Social Proof Strip
purpose: Add lightweight trust with logos or short quotes.

name: Compact Pricing
compositionNotes: Use clean borders and no oversized pricing decoration.

name: Minimal FAQ
purpose: Answer common questions without breaking rhythm.
compositionNotes: Use sparse dividers instead of boxed cards.

name: Download or Trial CTA
purpose: Drive trial, sign-up, demo, or app download.
compositionNotes: Keep the CTA section focused and compact.
